purpose: Prospectively test whether two frozen projected-write direction readers predict the complete grouped-MLP6--7 causal lattice on disjoint nouns and unseen inside/above syntax without any downstream backward pass on target text.
data_status: NEW_TEXT; native capability first; 512 fixed-reader predictions sealed before all causal outcomes

fixed_reader_artifact.note: Instrument/export gates pass; ambient distinctness gate is an explicit null.

novelty_audit: No prior event freezes downstream readers on one corpus and predicts a new corpus without target-tail gradients.
This tests extraction, OOD-style syntax transfer, composition, and operational reader reuse; it does not fit rank or causal outcomes.

stages.sealed_prediction: Generate new-text head displacements only, then dot with the already-frozen direction reader; zero downstream backward passes and zero causal outcomes.
stages.causal_validation: After binding the prediction SHA, evaluate the complete base/exact E/A/U/W lattice and score with no fitting.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_and_temporal_seal: All hashes/licenses/closures pass and exactly 512 sealed predictions precede 512 causal targets.
predictions.pred_b_fixed_readers_transfer: Overall cosine >=0.90, relative L2 error <=0.45, and sign agreement >=0.85.
predictions.pred_c_intermediate_composition_transfer: The 448 intermediate amplitudes have cosine >=0.90, relative L2 error <=0.45, and sign agreement >=0.85.
predictions.pred_d_each_new_template_transfers: Each template has cosine >=0.80, relative L2 error <=0.60, and sign agreement >=0.75.
predictions.pred_e_direction_choice_is_necessary: Correct frozen readers reduce SSE at least 50% versus swapping the two readers between answer directions.
predictions.pred_f_no_target_tail_or_calibration: Prediction uses zero target-tail backwards and no fitted scale, offset, endpoint, or causal q.

null: Failure of b-d means reader reuse is corpus-specific despite within-corpus LOO transfer. Failure of e means direction labels are unnecessary. No rescaling may rescue a gate. Ambient reader cosine is not re-tested or claimed.
